title: Parity of the incident supports
statement: For any natural numbers $n$ and $d$, take six pairwise disjoint $d$-element subsets of an $n$-element set, indexed by the edges of the complete graph on four vertices. For each vertex, let its incident support be the union of the three subsets indexed by edges containing that vertex. The symmetric difference of the four incident supports is empty.
